title: fragment 2 (Josquin, Omnes gentes)
desc: Josquin des Prez, Omnes gentes, fragment 2. 1 voices (Altus), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Jos9907b); encoded by Jesse Rodin. CC BY-NC 4.0. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff. No text in this edition.
